about_the_game:
The Master Tapes

The soundtrack to End Transmission? is comprised of Lena's favorite songs as heard in the game. Lena's tape machine only allows four instruments to be played at a time, but here you can listen to the full tracks with every instrument in all of their glory.

Recorded on cassette, of course!

Find out if your in-game mixes are superior to the real thing or simply enjoy the chill vibes of the seven original tracks released here for free.
